scope.boundary: Registry record plus attached evidence references only. No runtime, code or data inspection.

models.name: Support-LLM
models.provenance: vendor release note URL to be verified by owner

risk.interpretation: Internal prioritization indicator only; not a legal category, certification or safety determination.
risk.missingDataBehavior: Unknown inputs are scored 3 of 5 (mid-scale) and listed in unknownFactors; they are never treated as low.

rules.title: Named accountability
rules.reason: Owner and risk owner are named (owner declaration, not verified).
rules.ownerAction: Assign an accountable owner and a risk owner.

rules.title: Intended use and boundaries
rules.reason: Intended and prohibited uses are documented (owner declaration).

rules.title: No compliance claims
rules.reason: Engine design rule: output always requires human review and never states compliance.

rules.title: Evidence provenance
rules.reason: No control is verified by a named reviewer; presence of a file is not verification.
rules.ownerAction: Have a named reviewer verify controls.

rules.title: Data minimization
rules.reason: Data sources declared as metadata with no raw data attached (owner declaration).

rules.title: Human decision authority
rules.reason: Human checkpoints name a role and authority (declared; actual intervention not evidenced).

rules.title: Version traceability
rules.reason: All declared models and tools record a version.
rules.ownerAction: Record versions or mark them explicitly unknown.

rules.title: Risk uncertainty visible
rules.ownerAction: Resolve unknown risk dimensions or document why they stay unknown.

rules.title: Least privilege and tool consent
rules.reason: Every tool lists its permission scopes (declared).
rules.ownerAction: List least-privilege scopes for each tool.

findings.recommendedOwnerAction: Have a named reviewer verify controls.
